'''DarthVader,AOE DUEL OF THE FATES - Player's Preconstruct 9''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader,AOE]]
* '''Published:''' 10 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 WHT DarthVader,AOE LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

GPN Member built.

The published list has 65 cards.
